## Educational Guides
- [EU & US Dividend Withholding Tax Guide (2026): How Retail Investors Estimate Net Yield](https://b2appsdev-del.github.io/blog/eu-dividend-withholding-tax-guide-2026.html): Practical educational guide to understanding dividend withholding tax rates across EU and US equities, double-tax treaties, and how to model net yield.
- [Solana Smart Contract Starter Checklist: Project Structure, Testing & Pre-Audit Steps](https://b2appsdev-del.github.io/blog/solana-smart-contract-starter-checklist.html): A practical engineering checklist for structuring Solana token-sale and NFT smart contracts, running local tests, and preparing for security audits.
- [WCAG 2.2 AA Accessibility Audit Checklist for Modern Web Apps & SaaS](https://b2appsdev-del.github.io/blog/wcag-2-2-aa-accessibility-audit-checklist.html): Step-by-step contrast, keyboard navigation, ARIA, and focus-ring checks to make your web app WCAG 2.2 AA compliant.
